summary: Senior Software Engineer and Platform Architect with 20+ years of experience, including 11+ years in fintech. At Earnest from December 2019 to January 2024 - first on the Platform team via Wizeline, migrating a monolith to a modern microservice architecture for owned services spanning the full user lifecycle, then as a direct hire leading Growth engineering projects on AWS. Previously spent 7 years at Paybook designing and building its financial-data aggregation platform. Core strength: secure, high-throughput backend platforms - APIs, microservices, data systems, and CI/CD - that product teams build on.

philosophy.title: Pragmatic architecture
philosophy.description: Choose system boundaries and technologies based on the problem, operational reality, and long-term cost of ownership.

philosophy.title: Collaborative leadership
philosophy.description: Help product, design, analytics, and engineering turn ambiguity into a shared plan and a dependable release.

philosophy.title: Operational reliability
philosophy.description: Build observable, testable systems with clear ownership and the fewest moving parts the problem actually requires.

philosophy.title: Hands-on delivery
philosophy.description: Stay close to implementation, testing, tooling, and production behavior so architectural decisions remain grounded.

highlights: Joined as a direct hire after 18 months on Earnest's Platform team via Wizeline (below) - 4+ years total with the company.
Collaborated with the Growth team and diverse stakeholders, leading multiple engineering initiatives to optimize customer experience and top-of-the-funnel conversion across organizational boundaries.

Architected projects from initial first-principles planning through reliable production release across cloud stacks, including AWS Lambdas, AWS Gateways, user referral tracking systems, and Next.js static/incremental generation (SSG/ISR).
Partnered directly with product, marketing, lifecycle, and analytics leaders to define requirements and drive engineering execution while mentoring developers and improving CI/CD workflows.

experience.role: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Team (Client: Earnest)
highlights: Embedded on the Platform team at Earnest, a U.S. fintech company, as a core platform backend engineer - building the shared platform services other product teams built on.
Major initiative: migrating Earnest from a monolithic architecture to a modern microservice architecture.
Owned platform services that touched every part of the user lifecycle.

Engineered high-throughput, secure backend microservices using Node.js, AWS, Docker, Jenkins, PostgreSQL, and GraphQL, guiding backend system design and scalability in a regulated financial-services environment.

Joined the startup's small team and became the first engineer working on the financial data aggregation backbone that later became Paybook Sync; the platform was operational before the engineering team expanded.
Designed and implemented the architecture, scaling model, pipelines, cloud infrastructure, database schemas, DevOps tooling, and user-facing components.

Built and operated integrations across financial institutions in Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, the United States, and Europe, with tooling that helped a very small team respond quickly while minimizing user impact.

Designed and operate Anna (anna.gup.io), an autonomous AI assistant platform: Go/TypeScript services on Cloudflare Workers with an MCP-based tool gateway, persistent memory, and human-approval controls for autonomous actions.
Also built IncidentPulse (real-time incident-command platform), PRISM (zero-trust gateway for AI-agent tool calls), and Tributary (claims-and-attestations layer for git workflows).
Provided freelance software architecture, custom system development, and Linux security consulting across a 13-year span.

Architected AWS scaling-on-demand backend APIs, executed complex database migrations (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB), and engineered custom web/mobile applications; executed Linux server provisioning, kernel hardening, and vulnerability auditing.
Developed internal enterprise applications utilizing Perl and AJAX user interfaces to automate and monitor international VoIP networks.
Saved significant operational costs by creating an automated smart-recharging and dynamic routing engine for international voice traffic.
Provided top-level Linux system administration, kernel hardening, and security auditing across web hosting server clusters.
Responded to critical security vulnerabilities and diagnosed complex system performance bottlenecks.
